name: 10X Health System
tagline: Precision wellness clinics in Aventura and Scottsdale, with PRP and extracellular vesicle treatments through its HealthGAINS practice
description:
10X Health System is a precision wellness company started in 2021 by Grant Cardone and Brandon Dawson, with its head office and first clinic at the 10X Centre in Aventura, Florida. Most of the business is testing and infusions. Patients start with a methylation or precision genetic panel, a blood panel covering more than 70 biomarkers, and gut or mitochondrial screens, then a provider builds an IV drip, peptide, and supplement plan off the results. The in-clinic Superhuman Protocol is a PEMF mat, an oxygen training session, and red and near-infrared light.

The company does not offer stem cell therapy. No clinic in the group performs a cell transplant or infusion, and there is no offshore arm or referral partner that does one. Its regenerative work is platelet-rich plasma for joints, hair, and facial rejuvenation, plus an extracellular vesicle facial, and it runs through HealthGAINS, the Aventura hormone and regenerative practice 10X Health acquired in 2022. PRP is spun from the patient's own blood in the office on the day of treatment.

Three clinics take walk-in appointments: the flagship at the 10X Centre, the HealthGAINS office about a mile north at Aventura ParkSquare, and a clinic in North Scottsdale, Arizona. Beverly Hills and Las Vegas are mobile concierge visits rather than sites you can walk into. Clinical direction sits with national medical director Carrie Carda, MD, an OB/GYN, with market and regional medical directors under her.

PRP and extracellular vesicle treatments are investigational and are not FDA-approved for these uses. Nothing is priced publicly. A wellness concierge quotes each protocol after the assessment.

priceNote: No published price list. Testing, IV drips, peptides, and supplements are billed separately, and a wellness concierge quotes the protocol once a provider has reviewed the results. PRP and extracellular vesicle treatments at the HealthGAINS clinic are quoted the same way.

medicalDirector.name: Dr. Carrie Carda

team.name: Dr. Jeffrey Davidson
team.title: Market Medical Director
team.bio: Emergency physician and a fellow of the American College of Emergency Physicians. Handles clinical oversight at the market level.

team.name: Dr. Castel Santana
team.title: Regional Medical Director
team.bio: Covers clinical oversight for the clinics regionally, working across the testing, hormone, and IV programs.

team.name: Dr. Daniel Wallerstorfer
team.title: Chief Scientific Officer
team.bio: Austrian geneticist who founded the lab group Novogenia in 2009 and built the genetic panels behind the company's methylation and precision tests.

faqs.question: Do you offer stem cell therapy?
faqs.answer: No. 10X Health does not perform stem cell injections or infusions at any of its clinics, and it does not send patients overseas for them. The regenerative treatments on offer are platelet-rich plasma and an extracellular vesicle facial.

faqs.question: What cell products do you use?
faqs.answer: Platelet-rich plasma, spun from the patient's own blood in the office, and extracellular vesicles used in a facial treatment. Neither uses donor stem cells.

faqs.question: Is this FDA-approved?
faqs.answer: No. PRP and extracellular vesicle treatments are investigational and are not approved by the FDA for the uses offered here. They are elective procedures and are not a replacement for standard medical care.

faqs.question: What happens on a first visit?
faqs.answer: Testing comes first: a methylation or precision genetic panel, a blood panel of more than 70 biomarkers, and gut or mitochondrial screens where they apply. A provider reviews the results, then puts together an IV, peptide, and supplement plan.

faqs.question: How much does it cost?
faqs.answer: There is no published price list. A wellness concierge quotes the protocol after the assessment, and tests, IV drips, peptides, and supplements are billed separately.

faqs.question: Where are the clinics?
faqs.answer: Two in Aventura, Florida, one at the 10X Centre and one at Aventura ParkSquare, and one in North Scottsdale, Arizona. Beverly Hills and Las Vegas are covered by mobile concierge appointments instead of a walk-in clinic.
